actions.acknowledge_incident.props.fromE: PagerDuty REST write operations require the email address of a valid PagerDuty user on the account.

actions.create_incident.description: Create a new PagerDuty incident using the REST API.
actions.create_incident.props.assigneeId: Comma-separated list of PagerDuty user IDs to assign the incident to. Cannot be used together with Escalation Policy ID.
actions.create_incident.props.conference: Phone number of the conference bridge.

actions.create_incident.props.incidentKe: A string that identifies the incident. Duplicate requests with the same key and open incident on the same service will be rejected (de-duplication).
actions.create_incident.props.priorityId: The ID of the priority to assign to this incident.

actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to PagerDuty REST API v2. Authorization, Accept, and Content-Type headers are injected automatically. For write endpoints that require a From header, add it manually in the headers field.
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.get_incident.description: Retrieve a PagerDuty incident by ID.
actions.get_incident.props.incidentId.de: The PagerDuty incident ID, for example PABC123.
actions.list_incidents.description: List PagerDuty incidents with optional filters and pagination.
actions.list_incidents.props.limit.descr: Maximum number of incidents to return (1–100).
actions.list_incidents.props.offset.desc: Pagination offset (number of records to skip).
actions.list_incidents.props.since.descr: Optional start of the search window.
actions.list_incidents.props.until.descr: Optional end of the search window.
actions.resolve_incident.props.fromEmail: PagerDuty REST write operations require the email address of a valid PagerDuty user on the account.
actions.resolve_incident.props.incidentI: The PagerDuty incident ID, for example PABC123.
actions.resolve_incident.props.resolutio: Optional resolution note. PagerDuty adds this to the resolve log entry.
auth.description: PagerDuty REST API token from Integrations > API Access Keys. Activepieces sends it as Authorization: Token token=<API_KEY>.

triggers.incidentAcknowledged.descriptio: Triggers when an incident is acknowledged.
triggers.incidentAcknowledged.props.inst:
To receive new incident events, create a webhook subscription in PagerDuty with the following settings:
  - Go to **Integrations** > **Generic Webhook(V3)** in the PagerDuty dashboard.
  - Set the **Endpoint URL** {{webhookUrl}} to the URL of this trigger.
  - Add Scope types and Scope
  - Select event type.
  - create webhook
